input.quote: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21.1 sets a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, which matches our preferred position. The floor is not illusory: "Fees" (Section 1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, and Section 2.1 commits USD 2,000,000 of Services per year, so 12 months' Fees will normally exceed the USD 1,000,000 alternative. Section 21.2 contains a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages and helpfully confirms that data restoration, replacement services, required notices and reasonable incident response are direct damages. Section 21.3 defines "Excluded Claims" to cover confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP; because both 21.1 and 21.2 open with "Except for Excluded Claims", those claims sit outside the cap and the damages exclusion, so indemnities are not capped. Section 21.3 also confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not damages and is not limited by the Section, and Section 21.4 keeps each cap independent and effective on failure of an exclusive remedy. Nothing is one-sided against Customer, so no redline is warranted.
